name: ask-user
description: Ask the human a question via file handoff + desktop notification. 'ask' writes $AGENT_TOOLS_HOME/questions/<id>.json and polls answers/<id>.json until --timeout. 'answer' records a reply; 'list'/'read' inspect queue.
use_when: blocking on a human decision while staying non-interactive

args.name: ask
args.description: --question TEXT [--options a,b,c] [--timeout SEC] [--no-notify]. Emits {id, answer} on reply; exit 3 on timeout.

args.name: answer <id>
args.description: --text 'reply' or --option N (1-based). Humans/other processes answer here.
